rankings.summaryHtml: My main justification for picking against the Heat to three-peat was the historical evidence telling us how rare it is to make four straight trips to the Finals. But let's face it: Miami really only has to worry about one series now -- Indy in the East finals -- to be the first team since Boston in 1987 to pull it off.
